description:
THE ROOT finding of the epic's minimality arc (discovered by the fz-go4.18.17 attempt; full evidence + 547-line WIP patch preserved on that ticket / scratchpad). PROVEN: on fixtures2/behavior/fz_f98_range_map_converges.fz the joined return demand of FunctionId(174) flips Whole <-> TupleFields([Whole, Whole]) FOREVER, driven by FunctionId(201)'s alternating contribution (direct join tracing). The base system terminates ONLY because the unconditional demand-cone wipe (pull.rs invalidate_runtime_demand_dependents) removes BOTH cycle members' memos simultaneously, routing in-SCC reads through the fixed active-seed bootstrap — a SCHEDULE-FROZEN state, not a monotone fixpoint. Consequences proven by the .18.17 attempt: pure wavefront gating livelocks (the orbit runs forever, 23k productions); narrower SCC damping freezes an INCONSISTENT state (miscompile: 'backend value 4 is unbound' at encode_call_args); and the true dependency graph (reads ∪ join-contributions) makes every caller-callee pair a 2-cycle, so correct simultaneity degenerates to whole-call-graph re-marking.

THIS IS THE LIKELY COMMON ROOT of: fz-f98.14 (convergence runaway — the 1.3s schedule-dependent reseal), fz-go4.18.21 (schedule-dependent activation arrow keying), the .18.12 churn findings (.18.17 identical re-productions, .18.18 placeholder materialization, .18.20 re-analysis churn are all symptoms of the oscillating join), and the epic's historical schedule-dependence.

FIX DIRECTION (design work, convergence core — 'unknown is not none' / fz-rh2 monotone-by-construction family): the return-demand join must be a monotone function on a lattice where the orbit cannot exist — e.g. the join of Whole and TupleFields([Whole,Whole]) must be a FIXED value (widen to Whole, or a canonical tuple form) rather than alternating with contribution order; or contributions must be keyed so the alternation collapses. Requires understanding WHY 201's contribution alternates (is it itself reading the oscillating value = a feedback loop through the demand seed?). Acceptance: the orbit fixture converges monotonically WITHOUT the cone wipe (prove by applying the .18.17 wavefront gate on top and observing termination + ~0 identical re-productions); then .18.17's acceptance becomes reachable. Blocks fz-go4.18.17/.18.18/.18.20/.18.21.
title: Return-demand join is non-convergent (period-2 orbit); base termination relies on schedule-frozen cone wipes — make the join convergent by construction
